features.feature: Generated milestone closeout snapshots persist through the real DONE merge and worktree cleanup boundary.
Canonical story metadata contains milestone-closeout.json after DONE so worktree deletion does not lose the accepted closeout artifact.
The accepted milestone table is stored as committed durable story metadata rather than as a transient worktree-local file.
From the canonical root, lattice milestone_closeout --storyId=<story> reads a proofbound.milestone_closeout.v1 snapshot after DONE when the story had a completed risk-free milestone ledger.
Post-DONE regression coverage models a story worktree plus canonical main root and asserts canonical-root milestone_closeout succeeds after cleanup.
Regression coverage fails if the only milestone-closeout.json copy is worktree-local or deleted during DONE cleanup.
Incomplete or risky milestone reports remain fail-closed and do not produce accepted closeout snapshots.
Stories without milestone ledgers keep the existing missing or not-applicable diagnostic instead of fabricating closeout snapshots.
milestone_closeout remains a historical read-only snapshot reader and is not replaced with live milestone_status recomputation.
The durable closeout handoff stays inside the existing DONE effects and metadata path rather than introducing a separate fragile cleanup path.
